name: Wilbert D. Collins
original_name: ウィルバート・コリンズ
source:
Protagonist of Muv-Luv Unlimited: The Day After - Episode 00.

2nd lieutenant of the 12th Marine Tactical Armored Group in the US Marine Corps. Member of the VMF-318 Black Knives squad temporarily stationed in the JFK Naval Garrison Base.
